programme.desc: S08 E08 — Final Rendezvous Kelly and Steve investigate the mysterious murder of a devoted mother of four, found stabbed to death in her van with her wedding band on the floor; was an alleged secret affair behind the shocking crime?
programme.title: Cold Justice

programme.desc: S02 E01 — The Killing of Charlie Cosser At a summer party, 17-year-old Charlie Cosser is fatally stabbed; his dad's TikTok videos reveal a family shattered by senseless violence.
programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral

programme.desc: S13 E08 — Death Comes to Battletown When a city official is gunned down in Berryville, Va., shocked residents are left wondering who among them is a cold-blooded killer; as police dig into the victim's life, they learn not everyone held her in high regard.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Harold Shipman: Unexplained Deaths of a Doctor's Patients Unravel Dr. Harold Shipman's descent into darkness and the failures that allowed him to murder 250 patients; hear from a victim's family, dig into recordings and see why this respected GP's reputation kept him out of the spotlight for far too long.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Echoes of the Devil's Church A cursed church hides centuries of eerie legends and unexplained paranormal events.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Bad Company (The Chris Smith Story) Scratching the surface of Edward Shin's existence and seeing how the sociopath hid under a squeaky-clean exterior before his business partner, Chris Smith, started to dig up the truth.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Bell Island Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II; descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Ancient Architecture Puzzling over history-making structures and artifacts; Searching for clues about civilization's origins in Göbekli Tepe, visiting a German statue that reveals symbolic thought; witnessing the brutality of colonization in a Mexican skull tower.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E07 — The Ones that Got Away Joining the manhunt for three inmates who escaped Alcatraz in 1962; following the trail of pirate Henry Avery after he pulled off a massive heist in 1695, then stalking Axeman of New Orleans, a serial killer who taunted police but spared jazz lovers.
programme.title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files

programme.desc: It's Getting Hot in Here Get a bird's-eye view of a mysterious explosion in China and a quickly melting glacier on Earth's iciest continent; investigate an orange haze enveloping the Big Apple, then float over a toxic, too-hot-to-handle lake in New Zealand.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S01 E12 — Welsh UFOs Broadhaven, a sleepy little seaside village in Wales, is known as the UFO capital of Europe.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: Apparitions A look at why so many people see a vision of Jesus in seemingly normal things such as a tree stump or an antique cabinet.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Messages from Beyond TJ Swick's dreams are invaded by the spirit world with life changing consequences; a teen is targeted with demonic messages; a childhood friend returns from the other side to save Robert Salvas's life.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Priestess With The Golden Eye A golden-eyed priestess sparks myths of mystical powers and deep-rooted local folklore.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: S02 E16 — A Haunted Bar and More A destructive spirit wreaks havoc on a bar; three boys encounter a Sasquatch-like creature in the woods; dozens of worm-shaped UFOs appear over South America.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Here begins as a hunt for a paranormal research facility in America's most haunted state turns into a journey filled with discoveries for a team of supernatural investigators.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Island of the Greek Goddess Stone artifacts, burial grounds, and temple ruins shed light on an unknown civilization; the discovery of a green light emitting in a dark forest; the remains of a long-lost temple are found; coral rubble is unearthed on Suakin Island.
programme.title: Mysterious Islands
